items.title: Triba
items.description: Development of a complete digital magazine: subscription system, automated newsletter, editions catalog, and a contributor program with application form. Editorial design with smooth navigation and comfortable reading on any device.

items.title: SP Soluciones Textiles
items.description: Landing page for a textile business with service catalog, work gallery, and direct WhatsApp connection. Clean design with brand identity.

items.title: Multiservizi SRL
items.description: Italian funeral home offering wholesale products: ceramics, coffins, decorations and more. Complete digital catalog with smooth navigation.

items.quote: Working with Julián was a turning point for Triba. He instantly understood our vision and turned it into a digital magazine that truly represents us. Professional, patient, and with a great eye for detail.
items.name: Pilar Argañas

items.quote: Julián is one of those people who understand what you need before you say it. The Triba site looks flawless, with navigation that feels amazing. We will definitely keep working together.
items.name: Azul Argañas

items.quote: We needed a landing page that reflected the quality of our prints and Julián nailed it. Fast, neat, and incredibly patient with every change I asked for. Highly recommended.
items.name: Federico Pleitavino

items.quote: Building a website for a funeral home is not easy, but Julián found the right tone: serious, respectful, and functional. The online catalog opened many doors for us. Very happy with the result.
items.name: Gianluca Petrungaro

steps.title: Briefing
steps.description: We start with a conversation. You tell me your ideas, goals and expectations. We analyze your brand, your audience and the message you want to convey.

steps.title: Sketch
steps.description: I turn ideas into a visual concept. Information architecture, wireframes and interface design crafted to tell your story.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: Every line of code is designed to create a fluid, animated and optimized experience. Built with modern technologies that ensure performance and beauty.

steps.title: Iteration
steps.description: We review, adjust and refine until every detail aligns with the project's vision. Because the final result is born from collaboration.
